candidates.title: From Awareness to Adherence: Bridging the Context Gap in Spoken Dialogue Systems via Context-Aware Decoding
candidates.abstract: Despite the success of end-to-end (E2E) spoken dialogue systems, maintaining strict context adherence in multi-round conversations remains a challenge. While prior works attribute these failures to models forgetting dialogue history, we highlight an equally critical but overlooked bottleneck: a gap between latent context awareness and active adherence. Although models internally recognize relevant past utterances, strong parametric priors often overshadow these signals during decoding. To bridge this gap, we propose an audio-adapted Context-Aware Decoding (CAD) approach. By leveraging internal attention mechanisms to isolate key historical rounds, our approach contrasts output distributions with and without this key context during inference, directly amplifying multimodal contextual signals. Evaluations on the Audio MultiChallenge benchmark demonstrate significant improvements in Semantic Memory and Self Coherence subtasks, successfully enforcing strict, context-faithful adherence.
candidates.reason: 音声対話で潜在的な文脈認識が生成に反映されない乖離に対し、内部注意で重要履歴を分離し文脈あり・なしの出力分布を推論時に対比してマルチモーダル文脈信号を増幅する音声適応型Context-Aware Decodingを提案しており、デコード手法という推論機構への直接貢献が要旨で確認できる。

candidates.title: FlowHN: Adaptive Token Routing for Efficient Parallel Hybrid Networks
candidates.venue: Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics
candidates.reason: 本番LLM向けに注意機構とSSMの並列ハイブリッドで決定論的な条件付き計算を行うFlowHNは、FLOP認識型トークン循環でワークロードを均衡化し同期ストールを減らして最大4倍のスループットとMFU向上を示しており、推論アーキテクチャとスケジューリングへの直接貢献が要旨で確認できる。

candidates.title: ConvX: A Lightweight Converter to Bridge Indexed Dense Representations and Large Language Models for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
candidates.venue: Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics
candidates.reason: RAGで検索文脈が入力長を膨らませ二次計算量による推論レイテンシを悪化させる問題に対し、索引済み密表現を軽量コンバータで固定数のメモリスロットへ展開し長文文脈を置換することで入力長と計算量を削減するConvXを提案しており、LLM推論効率への直接貢献が要旨で確認できる。
